newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Huge overnight deals boost S.Africa's JSE volumes.
newsitem.headline: Huge overnight deals boost S.Africa's JSE volumes.

text.p: A series of large overnight deals boosted volumes on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange to more than 860 million rand in the first ten minutes of trade, dealers said.
Market sources said the series of deals, which were still going through the market, had been done by broker SBC Warburg. "It will be worth more than a billion rand once its over," one source said.

Shares involved included Johnnic, which was up 25 cents to 57.50 rand in trade worth 86 million rand, Dimension Data, which was down 20 cents to 16.00 rand in trade worth 76 million rand and Amgold, which was up 312 cents to 296.37 rand in trade worth 73 million rand.
Other shares were Engen which was up 14 cents to 21.79 rand in trade worth 42 million rand and Rembrandt which was down 50 cents to 45.50 rand in trade worth 36 million rand.
